record.question: The number of oxygen molecules carried by each Hb molecule is :
record.explanation: Answer D: 4. A hemoglobin molecule has four heme groups, each capable of binding one O₂ molecule; its maximum capacity is therefore four oxygen molecules. Actual occupancy varies with oxygenation. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK54103/; https://openstax.org/books/anatomy-and-physiology/pages/18-3-erythrocytes. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
